title: Servo on ESP32: compatible library and PWM

spans.text: The classic Arduino Servo library targets timer implementations on supported architectures such as AVR. ESP32 uses different LEDC/PWM hardware, and the library may not support the selected core, so an UNO sketch may fail to compile or run.
Connect the servo signal to ESP32 GPIO18. Power the servo from a suitable external supply and connect that supply's GND to ESP32 GND. The signal needs a shared ground reference.
Install ESP32Servo for the selected ESP32 board support package. Alternative: generate 50 Hz PWM with the ESP32 LEDC API. Platform: ESP32; use the standard Servo example on UNO.

spans.title: Important safety note
spans.text: Do not power a servo from the ESP32 3.3V pin; startup current can be high. Match the external supply to the servo datasheet and share GND.
